verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers what the skills do (TDD, triage, grilling, spec-writing) and how they're installed/updated, plus one marketplace-acceptance note, but nothing addresses the maintenance health of the repo itself — no evidence of release cadence, issue triage on the project's own tracker, or accepted community PRs/contributions. Community comments (comm-1/2/3) are about content quality/critique, not repo maintenance activity.
